dedupe_keys.name: borderstep data centres in the eu facts and figures first technical report on measured performance

description: This Borderstep page summarises the first EU assessment of the energy efficiency and sustainability of data centres based on measured values reported by operators under the EU reporting obligation. A consortium of the Borderstep Institute, EY and the Austrian Institute of Technology analysed the submissions for the European Commission's DG Energy and published the First Technical Report in 2025, which can be downloaded free of charge. The page explains the Energy Efficiency Directive goals (climate neutrality by 2030, higher efficiency, renewable energy, waste heat use and transparency) and key indicators: power usage effectiveness (PUE) averages between 1.15 and 1.66 across member states with an EU-wide value of 1.36, and water usage effectiveness (WUE) in cubic metres per MWh of IT energy, with further indicators charted. Producer: Borderstep, AIT and EY. Coverage: data centres in the EU member states that reported. Access: a public web summary and a free report download. Licence and cost: free; the reuse licence was not read. Caveats: the first round covers reporting operators only, is aggregated by country and depends on data quality. Simulation uses: EU baselines of PUE and WUE for data centre energy, water and climate-adaptation scenarios. Related record: the European database on the energy performance and water footprint of data centres (data-eu-data-centre-energy-performance-database).
